description: Generate a collection of edges representing a sub-parallel joint set within user-specified domain based on the characteristics defined by the following keywords:

keywords.name: angle
keywords.description: Angle of joint track to vertical v-axis (default = 0.0).

keywords.name: dip
keywords.description: Dip angle of the joint in 3D. . The dip is defined as the angle between the joint surface and the horizontal plane, measured downward from the dip direction (projected onto the xy-plane) toward the negative z-axis. The angle, in degrees, ranges from 0 to 90. By default, dip is set to 0.0.

keywords.name: dip-direction
keywords.description: Dip direction of the joint in 3D. Defines the azimuth of the joint dip, measured clockwise from the positive y-axis in the xy-plane. The value is expressed in degrees within the range [0, 360]. The default value is 0.0.

keywords.name: gap
keywords.description: Gap length between joint segments (default = 0.0). If defined, the joints are discontinuous and Trace has to be defined.

keywords.name: origin
keywords.description: Set the origin, or starting point, of the joint set. The first fracture generated will pass through this point.

keywords.name: trace
keywords.description: Trace length of joint segment (default = 0.0). If defined, the joints are discontinuous and Gap has to be defined.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Assign group name s1 in slot s2 (if supplied) to the joint set. If the slot keyword is omitted, slot Default is used.

keywords.name: keep-domain
keywords.description: If b = True , the domain is preserved. By the default, the domain is deleted each time after creating a joint set.

keywords.name: dip-direction-model
keywords.description: Dip-Direction of the plane of the 2D model. By the default, dip-direction-model is set to 0.0.

notes: FLAC2D only: the FLAC3D sketch rejects it.
Set the domain first with sketch joint-set domain; keep-domain on keeps it for the next create.
The manual also lists minimum-length; the 9.8 build reports it as an unused parameter.
